scripts.postinstall: npm install --prefix web && npm install --prefix functions
scripts.emulators: npm exec --prefix functions -- firebase emulators:start --only auth,firestore,functions
scripts.test: npm test --prefix web && npm exec --prefix functions -- firebase emulators:exec --only firestore --project tbo-feriados-test "cd functions && npx vitest run"
scripts.build: npm run build --prefix web && npm run build --prefix functions
